response.passage: At the corner of MG Road, Uncle Ramesh runs a popular stall selling spicy bhel puri. He started this business in 2012, serving office workers who rush out during their lunch break. The stall remains crowded because the aroma of his special tamarind chutney attracts hungry passersby from three blocks away. Last Tuesday, a local food blogger named Priya visited the stall to film a video. She noticed that the crowd size increases significantly whenever Ramesh adds extra roasted peanuts to the mixture. Because the peanuts provide a satisfying crunch, customers are willing to wait in long queues for their snack. Ramesh insists that the secret to his success is not just the ingredients, but the speed at which he serves each plate. He can prepare 45 plates in just one hour, ensuring that no one stays hungry for too long. While some nearby shopkeepers complain about the noise, the stall remains a staple of the neighborhood. Ramesh plans to expand his menu next year, hoping to serve even more people in the bustling city.
